token.description_note: The description is NOT stored on chain. The mint stores name, symbol and a uri; the uri is a content-addressed IPFS CID and the metadata update authority is null, so neither link can change.

wallet_attribution.evidence: The campaign wallet sent 70,000 TOAD to a brand-new token account that has exactly one transaction in its entire history, and 63 seconds later the X account @mdudas posted a screenshot of that balance while replying to the recipient. The receiving wallet's pump.fun username matches the handle replied to. The wallet and the X account are the same operator.
wallet_attribution.caveat: pump.fun exposes no x_username for this wallet. The binding rests on the wallet-proof exhibit and the matching pump.fun handle -- label it, never assert it as self-disclosed.

reconciliation.headline: Every base unit that entered the campaign wallet is accounted for.
reconciliation.sell_detection_method: An outbound transfer is a sale if its destination is a known liquidity venue (pool account or pool vault token account), or if the transaction invoked a DEX/swap program at any call depth. Anything not affirmatively identified as an ordinary keypair wallet is marked needs_review rather than assumed to be a gift.
reconciliation.sell_detection_note: 0 of the campaign wallet's outbound transfers went to a pool token account or invoked a DEX program at any CPI depth. All 202 destination owners are on the ed25519 curve, and every Solana pool authority is a PDA -- which is by construction OFF the curve -- so none of them can be a liquidity pool.

recipient_side.wording: moved_out means the tokens LEFT the wallet. That covers selling, sending to another wallet, and depositing to an exchange. It is not proof of a sale, and the site must not call it one -- sold is null because it was never measured.

reconciliation.invariant_is_the_test: This residual is also the pipeline's unit test. The previous collector queried the owner wallet with a 150-signature cap and reported 101 transfers / 9,033,500 TOAD. It was missing 61 transfers and 11,227,055 TOAD -- and the residual would have been nonzero on the first line of this build.

stats.total_usd_at_drop_exact_note: Reconciliation value. Do not render: it claims cent precision on a +/-2.7% estimate.

total_usd_at_drop_precision.method: amount x close of the 1-minute candle containing the transfer; probe order 0, -1, +1, -2 minutes
total_usd_at_drop_precision.why_rounded: A drop fills at some instant inside its minute, not at the close. The median candle spans 2.1977% high-to-low, so the total carries roughly +/-$7,207 of irreducible uncertainty. Render the rounded figure. Every digit past the third is invented precision.
total_usd_at_drop_precision.row_level_policy: Headline totals (stats.total_usd_at_drop, airdrop_daily[].usd) are published rounded to 3 significant figures. Per-transfer and per-recipient usd fields keep cent resolution so they still reconcile to *_exact. A rounded total therefore will not equal the sum of the rows -- that is the intended behaviour, not a bug.
total_usd_at_drop_precision.why_minute_not_hourly: Bucketing the same transfers hourly moves the total by $10,466 (3.2%). Hourly candles are not a cheaper approximation here; they are a different answer.

source.note: Never call either endpoint at runtime or from the browser.

launch.note: GeckoTerminal's first minute candle opens at $0.0000310836, which OVERSTATES the true launch by 14.7x because it misses the opening bonding-curve ticks. Launch price is taken from pump.fun; the `candles` series is GeckoTerminal only and is not spliced.

market.market_cap_basis: live circulating supply x last candle close; NOT a nominal 1B supply (1B would understate the top holder at 16.53% instead of 17.21%)

price_lookup.rule: bucket = ts // 60; probe minute offsets (0, -1, +1, -2) in that order
price_lookup.returns: (price_usd, minute_offset); offset 0 means the exact minute

drop_pricing.method: amount x close of the 1-minute candle containing the transfer; probe order 0, -1, +1, -2 minutes
drop_pricing.why_rounded: A drop fills at some instant inside its minute, not at the close. The median candle spans 2.1977% high-to-low, so the total carries roughly +/-$7,207 of irreducible uncertainty. Render the rounded figure. Every digit past the third is invented precision.
drop_pricing.row_level_policy: Headline totals (stats.total_usd_at_drop, airdrop_daily[].usd) are published rounded to 3 significant figures. Per-transfer and per-recipient usd fields keep cent resolution so they still reconcile to *_exact. A rounded total therefore will not equal the sum of the rows -- that is the intended behaviour, not a bug.
drop_pricing.why_minute_not_hourly: Bucketing the same transfers hourly moves the total by $10,466 (3.2%). Hourly candles are not a cheaper approximation here; they are a different answer.

concentration_excluding_infrastructure.note: Denominator is supply minus the excluded accounts, so these percentages describe concentration among holders who are not the treasury, the deployer, or a liquidity venue.

holders.concentration_note: The raw top-1 holder IS the campaign treasury at 17.21%, which reads as insider concentration when it is the opposite. Render the ex-infrastructure column beside it.

deployer_conduct.method: pool-touching transactions classified by the AMM program's own instruction name (Buy/Sell/Deposit/Withdraw) in the logs, with the direction of SOL as a cross-check -- NOT by TOAD direction alone
deployer_conduct.correction: TOAD moving from this wallet to the pool is NOT evidence of selling. A liquidity deposit sends TOAD *and* SOL to the pool and returns LP tokens. Any figure that lumps the two together overstates selling and misrepresents the deployer.

timeline.event: El Sapo Pepe debuts on Carlitos Bala's Argentine children's television show: green toad, red shirt, yellow suspenders. Seventeen years before the internet frog.
Matt Furie publishes Boy's Club #1 and introduces Pepe the Frog. The toad was already seventeen years old.
El Reino Infantil / La Granja de Zenon release the El Sapo Pepe song, which becomes a Latin American childhood anthem.
Mint created; deployer buys in the same transaction
timeline.note: The deployer is the fee payer of the mint-creation transaction AND the buyer inside it -- a same-block snipe of his own launch.

timeline.caveat: Timestamp attested by DexScreener, not by an on-chain walk: reaching this pool's first signature requires paginating its entire (very large) history. Constant-product PumpSwap pool: this is the canonical pricing venue. Never price off the Meteora DLMM pool.

timeline.event: Campaign wallet buys TOAD with USDC
timeline.note: Gas paid by relayer FHpcNSe6... (pump.fun mobile paymaster), so the buyer's wallet never needed SOL -- consistent with a mobile-app buy.
Tweet id was missing from the identity collection (X search is unauthorised); recovered from the social collector's keyless hydration of the curated moment list.

timeline.event: Deployer sends the bag to the campaign wallet, keeping exactly 20,000,000
timeline.note: Bought 200,963,210.657135 and forwarded 180,963,210.657135, leaving exactly 20,000,000.000000 -- a deliberate round number, not a residue.

timeline.event: First airdrop leaves the campaign wallet
timeline.note: Identified by scanning the ATA's COMPLETE signature history and taking the earliest outbound row -- not by reading the first page.

timeline.event: Peak market cap $24,702,219 (pump.fun ath_market_cap). The '~$50M peak' repeated elsewhere is not supported by any source we can read.

timeline.caveat: Account creation date requires GET /2/users/by/username with user.fields=created_at. The configured bearer token returns 401. The keyless syndication profile endpoint returns an empty body. Unverified.
